rows.criterion: H1 to H5, docs/verification/resolution-2026-10-17/health-criteria.md, committed in 2f40e9ba before any code or test it governs changed; the original row’s words and brief 11’s second reader’s decision kept beside them.

scopeResolution.authority: Brief 12, section 3: “Jobs remain removed. Do not restore employment to satisfy health.enroll’s work-hours branch. I authorize retaining that branch as a tested internal safeguard where it is necessary for existing data, compatibility, or defensible engine behavior. … If the branch serves no necessary purpose, document that finding before removing only that unreachable branch. Record this as an explicit scope resolution for health.enroll. Do not apply it to decision #4 or alter that decision’s protected rows.”
scopeResolution.finding: The branch served no necessary purpose (health-criteria.md, “The Finding”). Existing data: only the day-job builds (9a12c11a to 23485b8e, 24 to 26 September 2026, schema 89) posted paychecks whose memos state hours, and a life there worked whole-hour shifts where it lived, at no less than the floor ($7.25 in New Haven, $17.00 in New York City, $16.90 in California), so 80 hours paid at least $580.00, which the income test meets from the same postings (the migration took the pay record off). Compatibility: only two sentences read ‘work’; no save keeps it. Defensible behavior: the income prong is 80 hours at the federal minimum, and SLATE never paid under it where the rules are read, so the two never came apart.
scopeResolution.decision: Removed, alone: the branch, ‘work’ in EngagedBy and BY_WORDS; then PUBLIC_COVER.workHours, read by nothing once the notices said the player’s route. The finding committed first (2f40e9ba), the cut citing it (6d9fe683).
scopeResolution.decision4: Not read, not touched: decision 4’s twelve audit rows, three decision rows and the banking area’s eight items.

rows.exercised: Through the public command (sim.execute) and the drawn screens (Papers and Home rendered with renderToStaticMarkup under the house’s mocks; the guide’s entry by its address and the tutorial’s chapter in the guide’s dialog), on lives the creation screen makes, played by the clock, with a reload (loadSave of the frozen universe) in at least one test of the student, enrollment, renewal and hardship paths; the eligibility tests read the rule at a moment and have none. Until the second reader’s check of 2026-10-17 (brief12-health.json) this said a reload was in each path. The notices are read as Home’s What Needs You draws them, after the player presses Mark … Read (world.mark_read).
